title: The Group Chat of Maple Street
author: Elodie Delacroix
blurb: Felix Lockridge, the new kid at a school built over something old, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
